item.title: Fast calculation of the distance to cubic Bezier curves on the GPU
item.description:
📝 A glyph from the Virgil font, composed of multiple Bézier curves Having this distance field opens up many rendering possibilities. It's hard, but it's possible; here is a live proof: Distance to a cubic Bézier curve In this visualization, I'm borrowing your device resources to compute the distance to the curve for every single pixel. Distance from a random point to critical testing points of the curve The red dot in the blue field is a random point in space.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.pkh.me/p/46-fast-calculation-of-the-distance-to-cubic-bezier-curves-on-the-gpu.html

item.title: How I ditched smartphones
item.description:
📝 In the future, I will purchase a phone that runs entirely on Linux for the convenience of working with applications. Changing the IMEI with the same SIM card is useless, as the new IMEI will have the old IMSI. I understand that there are a LOT of caveats with this configuration, but this is only the beginning of such a journey into the world of radical privacy.
🔗 Read more: https://discuss.techlore.tech/t/how-i-ditched-smartphones/15315
